entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara that split off and lost its white and green mana, now overrun by necromancers, demons and undead, where humanity may go extinct within years.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The mega-plane from which Grixis separated, divided into five shards.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: A white-aligned human empire on the land that became Grixis, proud of its dynasty of wise and honorable monarchs.

entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: The last Vithian king, once human and wise, who bargained with demons to become a lich, massacred his family, and now rules Sedraxis as a lich warlord.

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: The former capital of Vithia, now the largest necropolis on Grixis, named after Sedris.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: Humans of Vithia and their descendants, who survive in hermitages and fight undeath with red and blue magic.

entities.name: Necromancers of Grixis
entities.description: Necromancers who rose with black mana and raised armies of the dead, seizing Vithia's strongholds.

entities.name: Demons of Grixis
entities.description: Demonic forces that tempted Sedris and later conquered the lands of the living.

entities.name: Hermitages
entities.description: Remote, ward-covered strongholds where surviving humans of Grixis shelter.

entities.name: Vis
entities.description: The precious energy of life that necromancers seek to power their spells.

events.summary: Grixis separated from Alara and lost access to white and green mana.
events.quote: But when the subplane became separated from the others, it lost access to its white and green mana.

events.summary: Black mana rose along with necromancers and demons, and Vithia's defenses failed over time.
events.quote: Over time, the defenses of Vithia failed.

events.summary: Demons tempted Sedris, and he handed thousands of his people to them in exchange for the power and unlife of a lich.
events.quote: Sedris handed the lives of thousands of humans in his kingdom to demons in exchange for the power and unlife of a lich.

events.summary: Sedris massacred his family and advisors in a bloody ritual to continue his consciousness as a lich; the knights who failed to stop him died with the word grixis on their tongues.
events.quote: Sedris massacred all of his family and close advisors to fuel the bloody ritual that would ensure the continuation of his consciousness into unlife.

events.summary: The kingdom flooded with demons and undead, the capital fell and became the necropolis Sedraxis, still ruled by Sedris.
events.quote: The capital fell, and just as Sedris had changed, the capital of Vithia, too, became something else.

events.summary: Necromancer barons and demon lords conquered more of the lands of the living, and the plane became known as Grixis.
events.quote: After the corruption of Sedris, the plane became known as Grixis.

relations.note: Sedris, now a lich warlord, still rules the necropolis.
relations.quote: It's still ruled by Sedris, now a lich warlord

relations.note: He bargained with demons for lichdom.
relations.quote: Demons, unable to assault the kingdom directly, instead tempted its leader with dreams of power, and he fell.
Today it's known as Sedraxis, the largest necropolis on the plane
Before Grixis split off from the mega-plane of Alara, things were different.
